objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, translated, invalidated, reactivated, and linked in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document object; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation options.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name includes document type abbreviation, consecutive number per type, and title.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per type included in the name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata printed in the document using TAG technology and documented for released versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata printed in the document and used in status networks, workflow status, released state, editing status, and out of force status.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to relevant companies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to areas of validity.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning the registered author and personal authorization.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers and personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers and personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser_incl_translation
attributes.description: Attribute referenced for setting authorizations during reactivation.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing user groups and persons for email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing user groups and persons for distribution of workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the period of extended validity is calculated.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined per document type for checking extended validity.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined per document type for archived documents.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version must be in released state before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which released language version is visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover object to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific data maintained for document properties.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose, such as Master data or Control (release).

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing format used by the editing client to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Format to which a saved document is automatically converted and displayed on the web.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to user groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to grant rights.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using the system and participating in roles, workflows, distribution, acknowledgements, and dashboards.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual assigned personal authorizations, distribution, and workflow roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned to document authorizations, reader groups, distribution, and roles.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role that can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role assigned to author or co-author selection list, able to create document types and change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights but no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document and its content and decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: User who creates a document or request and performs creator workflow steps.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow used for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation.

objs.name: workflow_step
objs.description: Step in a workflow, such as Creator, Review, Release, or initiator step.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: workflow_participant
objs.description: User involved in a workflow who completes tasks.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Documented signature of individual participants that can be printed as document content.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system about workflow tasks, document release, change proposals, acknowledgements, and distribution.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: main_document
objs.description: Document to which additional information or attachments are added.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document created and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: cockpit
objs.description: Area where change proposals and distribution lists for a document are managed and displayed.

objs.name: folder
objs.description: Container such as Change proposals folder or folder for reactivation requests.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to the document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document through the AKS workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents while other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning user groups or persons for release information or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view filled using distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status.

objs.name: selection_parameter
objs.description: Parameter available for reports that influences evaluation results.

objs.name: selection_criteria
objs.description: Criteria available for reports that filter result lists.

objs.name: traffic_light_system
objs.description: Visual status display used in status reports based on validity or workflow status timing.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a document checked, released, and visible in the corresponding login language.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Entity referenced by the relevant companies document property.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Entity referenced by the areas of validity document property.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the document type when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover to which files or documents can be uploaded or generated.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata via property editing.

evts.name: maintain_attribute
evts.description: Maintain document attributes via document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with an implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current version as a PDF on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to the content of a document.

evts.name: change_document_properties
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Create a new editing version when released documents are changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations to documents.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information without affecting the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment, triggering or occurring with document version release.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark released attachments for archiving before they are archived with the next main document version release.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Start the 3-step release process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs in the first workflow step of Creator.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content and complete the review workflow task.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete release task positively to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs users of workflow status, workflow tasks, release, change proposals, or acknowledgements by e-mail.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete assigned workflow tasks.

evts.name: sign_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete workflow tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new version automatically in editing status.

evts.name: retain_previous_version_data
evts.description: Retain all data from the previous version when a new version is created.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, and update valid until date.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after validity is extended or revised version is released.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a revised new version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the first step of AKS process.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Reviewers and releasers review and approve the AKS.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalid documents by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for reactivation request.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new version and restoring status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution list for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned user groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement via workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: provide_acknowledgement_overview
evts.description: Provide the author team an overview of acknowledgements not yet confirmed.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify author team when all persons maintained in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups.

evts.name: list_relevant_document
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: select_document
evts.description: Select a document from the dashboard list to display detailed information.

evts.name: display_detailed_information
evts.description: Display details such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions in the footer.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: assign_translation_participant
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing the translation in document properties.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to the original document from the extended local document.
